problem_statement_scheme_mapping.note: The user's SIH problem statement describes two tiers: Micro Finance Scheme (project cost <= Rs 1.40 lakh, 6.5% interest, 3-year tenure, 3-month moratorium) and Term Loan Scheme (project cost Rs 1.40 lakh to Rs 50 lakh, 8% interest, 7-year tenure, 6-month moratorium), both with 10% margin / 90% loan. None of the schemes catalogued above match these exact figures verbatim. This strongly suggests the problem statement is based on a specific state-level SCA (State Channelizing Agency) scheme document -- most likely from GSCDC, GBCDC, NSFDC (National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation), or NBCFDC (National Backward Classes Finance and Development Corporation) -- that has not yet been located and verified.
problem_statement_scheme_mapping.recommended_action: Contact DIC Mehsana or GSCDC/GBCDC district office directly to obtain the exact GR. NSFDC and NBCFDC are worth checking first since 'SCA' (State Channelizing Agency) is specifically NSFDC/NBCFDC terminology.

recommended_next_steps: Verify each 'needs_confirmation' scheme against its official GR/guideline PDF
Search NSFDC (nsfdc.nic.in) and NBCFDC (nbcfdc.gov.in) specifically, since 'SCA' terminology in the problem statement matches their channelizing-agency model
Contact District Industries Centre (DIC), Mehsana for the current locally-operative scheme list
Add source_document_date and source_document_name once primary documents are obtained
Re-verify subsidy/interest figures periodically, since state schemes have fixed operative windows and get revised
